title: Concept: Link to an application log file
description: A link whose path names a debug or error log in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: Application logs record stack traces, SQL, user identifiers and sometimes credentials, and a link to the log makes every one of those entries reachable with one request.
applicability: Debug pages, support tools and misconfigured static hosting.
risk: Logs carry the internal detail of every failure, including the data that caused it.
